notes: min-chuts is fused as one preposition under rule 30 and the flanking 'el and lamed are left unrepresented under rule 40; folding 'el into the fusion as a three-morpheme unit was the competing reading.
before his face is split rather than fused, since the ASV writes an English word for each of the three morphemes, exactly as rule 30's li-fnei to meet example directs.
one in one shall slay her is the pronoun realizing the impersonal verb's person and number, not a supplied lexical subject noun (rule 17).
